description: How busy one day is in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco): events per category, free and verified-location counts, whether the day is quiet, normal or busy against the same kind of day in the next 14 days (unknown further out) and top_curated, our editorial picks (occurrence_id, title, starts_at; empty while nothing is rated). An event counts once per day. Pass when (today, tonight, tomorrow) or date; time_from counts only events starting at or after it (busyness stays day-level). Use it for 'is there a lot on this Saturday' before search_events.

date.description: The day in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD. Required unless when is given.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area'), any case.

time_from.description: Count only events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours), for 'tonight'. Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are not counted.

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.

when.description: today, tonight (today from 18:00 unless time_from is given), tomorrow, in the hub's local calendar; echoed as resolved. Replaces date (naming both is an error).

name: get_day_overview
title: Day overview
